title: Efficacy Study of Articaine Lozenge to Enhance the Procedural Compliance of the Adults Undergoing Gastroduodenoscopy
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to examine in prospective, double-blinded randomised manner the ability of novel articaine-containing lozenge to enhance the procedure related compliance (compared to placebo) of the adult patients undergoing upper gastrointestinal endoscopy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* elective procedure
* weight over 40 kg
* American Society of Anesthesiology class I-III
* first upper GI endoscopy procedure
* finnish or/and swedish speaking

Exclusion Criteria:

* amide and/or esther local anaesthetic allergy
* paraben allergy
* Child-Pugh grade B/C liver failure
* renal insufficiency (calculated glomerular filtration rate under 60 ml/min/1.73 m2 according to Cockcroft-Gault scale )
* dementia
* those presenting with swallowing problem
* chronic pain condition
* chronic use of pain medication
* pregnancy
* lactation
